profile.name: Alex Morgan
profile.headline: I design and build fast, reliable software for the web — from database schemas and APIs to polished, accessible interfaces.
profile.bio:
I’m a software developer with **5+ years** of experience shipping products used by thousands of people every day. I enjoy working across the whole stack, but I’m happiest designing clean APIs, scalable backend systems and interfaces that feel effortless.

These days I’m building developer tooling and data-heavy dashboards with `TypeScript`, `Go` and `PostgreSQL`. I care deeply about performance, readable code and a thoughtful developer experience.

When I’m away from the keyboard you’ll find me contributing to open source, writing about what I learn, or exploring a new hiking trail.

experience.description: Leading development of a real-time analytics platform that processes **2M+ events a day**. I own the API layer, drove the migration from a monolith to event-driven services, and mentor a team of four engineers.
Built and scaled the customer-facing web app from 10k to 150k monthly users. Cut page load times by **45%** with code-splitting, edge caching and a redesigned data-fetching layer.
Shipped features for an e-commerce platform and wrote the team’s first end-to-end test suite, catching regressions before every release.
